highlights.reason_zh: AstaBrief-8B 的公开权重与本地流程让引文质量可以独立验证。
highlights.reason_en: AstaBrief-8B's public weights and local workflow make citation quality independently testable.

highlights.reason_zh: Copilot 把 agent 从代码界面扩展到桌面操作和代码化工作流。
highlights.reason_en: Copilot extends agents from code surfaces to desktop actions and code-defined workflows.

highlights.reason_zh: Argo-Bench 按最终业务行动评分，更接近生产数据 agent 的验收。
highlights.reason_en: Argo-Bench grades final business actions, closer to production data-agent acceptance.

highlights.reason_zh: SGLang 0.5.21 支持运行时切换 prefill/decode 角色。
highlights.reason_en: SGLang 0.5.21 switches prefill and decode roles at runtime.

highlights.reason_zh: OpenAI API 的 2027 下线日期把迁移从提醒变成排期任务。
highlights.reason_en: OpenAI's 2027 API shutdown dates turn migration from a warning into scheduled work.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；另核查官方 release、模型卡、代码仓库和论文。三项到期复核已完成。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and read, supplemented by official releases, model cards, repositories and papers. Three due reviews were completed.
